source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 7 (PDF 144-166), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 7 (Reaction Kinetics) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 What is reaction kinetics? What does it include?
(Reaction kinetics kya hai? Is mein kya shamil hai?)
blocks.explanation: Reaction kinetics chemical reactions ke rates (raftaar) ka mutala hai. Is mein reaction rates, orders aur mechanisms naapne ke mukhtalif tajurbati tareeqe shamil hain.

book_ref.quote: Reaction kinetics is the study of the rates of chemical reactions.

blocks.prompt:
2 Why are the rates of reactions and their control important in industry?
(Industry mein reactions ke rates aur un ka control kyun aham hai?)
blocks.explanation: Rates aur un ka control yeh tay kar sakte hain ke koi reaction kifayat (economically) se istemal ho sakta hai ya nahi. Kyunke bohat se factors rate par asar daalte hain, is liye woh halaat dhoondna zaroori hai jin mein reaction sab se kifayati ho.

book_ref.quote: It is important to discover the conditions under which the reaction will proceed most economically.

blocks.prompt:
3 Give one example each of a very fast, a moderate and a slow reaction.
(Bohat tez, darmiyani aur aahista reaction ki aik aik misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Bohat tez: NaCl ka AgNO₃ se reaction (dhamaka is se bhi tez, second ke hisse mein). Darmiyani: ester ki hydrolysis. Aahista: lohe ko zang lagna, jo dinon ya mahinon leta hai.

book_ref.quote: rates of different chemical reactions differ greatly

blocks.prompt:
4 State the main idea of collision theory.
(Collision theory ka bunyaadi khayal bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Collision theory batati hai ke reaction kaise hota hai: reactant particles (atoms, ions ya molecules) homogeneous mixture bana kar aapas mein takrayein. Effective takkar se products bante hain; ineffective takkar mein particles bas wapas uchhal jaate hain.

book_ref.quote: for a chemical reaction to take place, the particles atoms, ions or molecules of reactants must form a homogeneous mixture and collide with one another

blocks.prompt:
5 Differentiate between effective and ineffective collisions.
(Effective aur ineffective collisions mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Effective takkar se products bante hain; ineffective se nahi.

book_ref.quote: The effective collisions can take place only when the colliding particles possess certain amount of energy

rows: Products bante hain.
Products nahi bante; particles wapas uchhal jaate hain.
Particles ke paas kam az kam activation energy hoti hai.
Particles ke paas kaafi energy (ya durust rukh) nahi hota.
Particles durust rukh (proper orientation) se milte hain.
Rukh ya energy munasib nahi hoti.
Alag hone wale molecules kimiyaai taur par mukhtalif hote hain.
Wohi molecules baghair tabdeeli wapas uchhal jaate hain.

blocks.prompt:
6 Define activation energy. Why are most reactions slow?
(Activation energy ki definition likhein. Aksar reactions aahista kyun hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Activation energy reacting species ki effective takkar ke liye darkaar kam se kam energy hai. Aksar reactions aahista hain kyunke saari takkarein barabar effective nahi hoteen; sirf woh molecules products dete hain jin ke paas activation energy (aur durust rukh) ho.

book_ref.quote: The minimum amount of energy, required for an effective collision between the reacting species, is called activation energy.

blocks.prompt:
7 What is the activated complex? Where does it appear on the energy graph?
(Activated complex kya hai? Energy graph par yeh kahan hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Potential energy aur reaction ke raaste ke graph par reactants curve ki choti par pohanch kar activated complex banate hain. Sirf activation energy wale molecules yeh pahari chadh kar products dete hain.

book_ref.quote: The reactants reach the peak of the curve to form the activated complex.

blocks.prompt:
8 Why is a negative sign used with Δ[A]/Δt and a positive sign with Δ[B]/Δt for the reaction A → B?
(A → B ke liye Δ[A]/Δt ke saath manfi aur Δ[B]/Δt ke saath musbat nishan kyun lagaya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Rate = −Δ[A]/Δt = +Δ[B]/Δt. Manfi nishan reactant A ki concentration ke kam hone ko zahir karta hai (taake rate musbat aaye). Product B ki concentration waqt ke saath barhti hai, is liye us ka nishan musbat hai.

book_ref.quote: Since the concentration of product increases with time, the sign in rate expression involving the change of concentration of product is positive.

blocks.prompt:
9 Give the units of the rate of reaction. How do they change for slow and gas phase reactions?
(Reaction ke rate ki units batayein. Aahista aur gas phase reactions mein yeh kaise badalti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Rate = concentration/waqt, aam taur par mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹. Aahista reaction ke liye mol dm⁻³ min⁻¹ ya mol dm⁻³ h⁻¹. Gas phase reaction mein molar concentration ki jagah pressure ki units istemal hoti hain.

book_ref.quote: The rate of reaction has the units of concentration divided by time.

blocks.prompt:
10 For A → B, what do the concentration-time curves show at the beginning and at the end of the reaction?
(A → B ke concentration-time curves reaction ke shuru aur aakhir mein kya dikhate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Shuru mein slopes sab se zyada hain: [A] tezi se girta aur [B] tezi se barhta hai. Phir slopes kam hoti hain, reaction aahista hota hai; aakhir mein dono curves parallel (seedhe) ho jaate hain, yeh reaction ke mukammal hone ki stage hai.

book_ref.quote: ultimately both the curves become parallel

blocks.prompt:
11 In a reaction A → B, the concentration of B rises from 0.10 mol dm⁻³ to 0.46 mol dm⁻³ in 2.0 minutes. Calculate the average rate in mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹.
(A → B mein B ki concentration 2.0 minute mein 0.10 se 0.46 mol dm⁻³ ho jati hai. Average rate mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹ mein nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Where Δx is a very small change in the concentration of a reactant or a product in a very small time interval Δt.

blocks.prompt:
12 Differentiate between instantaneous rate and average rate.
(Instantaneous rate aur average rate mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Instantaneous rate aik lamhe ka, average rate aik waqfe ka hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The rate at any one instant during the interval is called the instantaneous rate.

rows: Waqfe ke kisi aik lamhe ka rate.
Do khaas auqaat ke darmiyan, yani poore waqfe ka rate.
Us lamhe par concentration-time curve ke tangent ki slope se milta hai.
Concentration ki kul tabdeeli ÷ waqfa.
Waqfe ke shuru mein average se zyada, aakhir mein kam.
Poore waqfe ke liye aik hi qeemat.

blocks.prompt:
13 When are the average rate and the instantaneous rate equal? How do they compare at the start and end of an interval?
(Average aur instantaneous rate kab barabar hote hain? Waqfe ke shuru aur aakhir mein in ka muqabla kaisa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kisi waqfe mein yeh sirf aik lamhe ke liye barabar hote hain. Shuru mein instantaneous rate average se zyada hota hai; aakhir mein average se kam ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: The average rate and instantaneous rate are equal for only one instant in any time interval.

blocks.prompt:
14 In N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) → 2NH₃(g), [NH₃] is 1.5 mol dm⁻³ after 1.0 min and 4.5 mol dm⁻³ after 3.0 min. Find the average rate of formation of NH₃.
(N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) → 2NH₃(g) mein [NH₃] 1.0 min par 1.5 aur 3.0 min par 4.5 mol dm⁻³ hai. NH₃ banne ka average rate nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: ΔC = 4.5 − 1.5 = 3.0 mol dm⁻³; Δt = 2.0 min. Average rate = 3.0/2.0 = 1.5 mol dm⁻³ min⁻¹.

book_ref.quote: Rate of formation of NH₃ = ΔC/Δt = Δ[NH₃]/Δt = 2.7 mol dm⁻³ / 3 min = 0.90 mol dm⁻³ min⁻¹

blocks.prompt:
15 How is the instantaneous rate at a given time found from a concentration-time curve?
(Concentration-time curve se kisi waqt par instantaneous rate kaise nikala jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Us waqt par curve ka tangent (mamas) khenchein aur us ki slope napein; yahi us lamhe ka instantaneous rate hai. Lambe waqfe ki tabdeeli ko waqt se taqseem karne se sirf average rate milta hai.

book_ref.quote: The slope of the tangent is the rate of reaction at that point i.e., after 100 seconds.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Misaal: agar 1.0 min se 4.0 min tak tabdeeli 2.7 mol dm⁻³ ho to 2.7/3 = 0.90 sirf average rate hai. 1.0 min ka fauri rate graph par 1.0 min wale nuqte par tangent bana kar us ki slope se milega.
7.2.2 Measuring the rate of a chemical reaction

blocks.prompt:
16 How is the rate of reaction at a particular time found from a concentration-time graph?
(Concentration-time graph se kisi khaas waqt par rate kaise maloom kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Us waqt (maslan 100 s) par curve ka tangent banayein aur tangent ko hypotenuse bana kar right-angled triangle ABC mukammal karein. Tangent ki slope ΔC/Δt us nuqte par rate hai.

book_ref.quote: In order to measure the rate of reaction, draw a tangent say, at 100 seconds, on the curve and measure the slope of that tangent.

blocks.prompt:
17 For 2HI(g) → H₂(g) + I₂(g), why is the [HI]-time graph a falling curve while the [H₂]-time graph is a rising curve?
(2HI(g) → H₂(g) + I₂(g) mein [HI]-time graph girta hua aur [H₂]-time graph barhta hua kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: HI reactant hai jo khatam hota hai, is liye us ki concentration girti hai. H₂ aur I₂ products hain, un ki concentration waqt ke saath barhti hai.

book_ref.quote: Since HI is a reactant, so it is a falling curve.

blocks.prompt:
18 Using Table 7.1 ([HI] = 0.0387 mol dm⁻³ at 200 s and 0.0296 mol dm⁻³ at 300 s), find the average rate between 200 s and 300 s. Compare it with the rate in the first 50 s (5.68 × 10⁻⁴ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹).
(Table 7.1 se ([HI] 200 s par 0.0387 aur 300 s par 0.0296 mol dm⁻³) 200 s se 300 s ka average rate nikalein. Pehle 50 s ke rate (5.68 × 10⁻⁴) se muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Rate = (0.0387 − 0.0296)/100 = 9.1 × 10⁻⁵ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹. Yeh pehle 50 s se taqreeban chhe guna kam hai, yani HI khatam hone ke saath reaction aahista hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Table 7.1 Change in concentration of HI with regular intervals, 2HI(g) → H₂(g) + I₂(g)

blocks.prompt:
19 In 2HI(g) → H₂(g) + I₂(g), HI disappears at 4.0 × 10⁻⁴ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹ at a certain time. At what rate is I₂ formed? Give the reason.
(2HI(g) → H₂(g) + I₂(g) mein kisi waqt HI 4.0 × 10⁻⁴ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹ se khatam ho raha hai. I₂ kis rate se banega? Wajah dein.)
blocks.explanation: Do mole HI se aik mole I₂ banta hai, is liye I₂ aadhe rate se banega: 4.0 × 10⁻⁴ / 2 = 2.0 × 10⁻⁴ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹.

book_ref.quote: two moles of HI give one mole each of H₂ and I₂

blocks.prompt:
20 Write the equation for the acid hydrolysis of ethyl acetate. Which method is used to follow its rate?
(Ethyl acetate ki acid hydrolysis ki equation likhein. Is ka rate kis tareeqe se dekha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: CH₃COOC₂H₅(l) + H₂O(l) → CH₃COOH(l) + C₂H₅OH(l), H⁺ catalyst. Is ka rate chemical method (banne wale acetic acid ki titration) se dekha jata hai, jo solution ke reactions ke liye munasib hai.

book_ref.quote: This is particularly suitable for reactions in solution.

blocks.prompt:
21 In following ester hydrolysis, why is the withdrawn sample run into ice-cold water?
(Ester hydrolysis mein nikala gaya sample barf jaise thande paani mein kyun daala jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sample ko apne volume ke taqreeban chaar guna thande paani mein daala jata hai kyunke dilution aur thandak reaction rok dete hain. Phir us waqt ka acid standard NaOH se phenolphthalein ke saath titrate hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The dilution and chilling stop the reaction.

blocks.prompt:
22 What information is obtained by repeating the titration at various times in ester hydrolysis?
(Ester hydrolysis mein mukhtalif auqaat par titration dohrane se kya maloomat milti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mukhtalif waqfon par titration dohrane se banne wale acetic acid ki concentration ki waqt ke saath tabdeeli milti hai, jis se rate maloom hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The analysis is repeated at various time intervals after the start of reaction.

blocks.prompt:
23 When can spectrophotometry (colorimetry) be used to follow a reaction?
(Spectrophotometry (colorimetry) se reaction kab follow kiya ja sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jab koi reactant ya product ultraviolet, visible ya infrared radiation jazb kare. Jazb hone wali radiation ki miqdaar naap kar rate maloom hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The rate of reaction can be measured by measuring the amount of radiations absorbed.

blocks.prompt:
24 Which reactions can be studied by the electrical conductivity method? Why?
(Kaunse reactions electrical conductivity method se parhe ja sakte hain? Kyun?)
blocks.explanation: Ions wale reactions. Solution ki conductivity (bijli guzaarne ki salahiyat) ions par munhasir hai, is liye ions ke khatam hone ya banne se conductivity badalti hai aur un ki concentration ki tabdeeli zahir karti hai.

book_ref.quote: The rate of a reaction involving ions can be studied by electrical conductivity method.

blocks.prompt:
25 What is the volume change method of following a reaction?
(Reaction follow karne ka volume change method kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh un reactions ke liye hai jin mein gases ka volume badalta hai. Nikalne wali gas ka volume waqt ke saath naapa jata hai; volume ki tabdeeli reaction ki pesh-raft aur concentration ki tabdeeli ke barah-e-raast mutanasib hai.

book_ref.quote: The volume change is directly proportional to the extent of reaction, and changes in concentration.

blocks.prompt:
26 What is stopped-flow spectrophotometry?
(Stopped-flow spectrophotometry kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bohat tez reactions dekhne ki technique. Reactants ki bohat thori miqdaar tezi se mixing chamber mein aur phir observation cell mein jaati hai, jahan aam taur par UV radiation ke guzarne se pesh-raft naapi jati hai; rate-time graph khud ban jata hai.

book_ref.quote: In this technique, very small volumes of reactants are driven at high speed into a mixing chamber.

blocks.text: 7.3 Factors affecting the rate of a chemical reaction

blocks.prompt:
27 List the factors that affect the rate of a chemical reaction.
(Chemical reaction ke rate par asar daalne wale factors ki fehrist dein.)
blocks.explanation: Wohi reactants mukhtalif halaat mein mukhtalif rate se react kar sakte hain. Factors: (1) reactants ki concentration, (2) system ka temperature, (3) surface area, (4) catalyst. Gases mein pressure bhi concentration ke zariye asar karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Even a chemical reaction involving the same reactants may have different rates under different conditions.

blocks.prompt:
28 How does pressure affect the rate of a reaction? Why has it no effect when the reactants are solids or liquids?
(Pressure reaction ke rate par kaise asar daalta hai? Solids ya liquids mein asar kyun nahi?)
blocks.explanation: Gaseous reactants mein pressure barhane se gases ki concentration barhti hai aur rate barhta hai. Solids ya liquids mein pressure ka rate par asar nahi hota kyunke is se un ki concentration nahi badalti.

book_ref.quote: pressure change has no effect on the rate of reaction if the reactants are either solids or liquids

blocks.prompt:
29 Explain the effect of concentration on the rate of reaction.
(Concentration ka reaction ke rate par asar wazeh karein.)
blocks.explanation: Law of mass action ke mutabiq reactants ki concentration jitni zyada, reaction utna tez. Zyada concentration se reacting particles ki takkarein zyada hoti hain, is liye reaction tez hota hai.

book_ref.quote: increasing the concentration results in more collisions between the reacting particles

blocks.prompt:
30 What is the Boltzmann distribution curve? What does its shaded area beyond Eₐ show?
(Boltzmann distribution curve kya hai? Eₐ se aage shaded area kya dikhata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh graph kisi khaas temperature par molecular energies ki taqseem dikhata hai: kuch ki energy bohat kam, kuch ki bohat zyada aur zyada tar ki darmiyani. Eₐ se aage shaded area un particles ki tadaad hai jin ki energy activation energy se zyada hai, yani jo takkar par react kar sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: The Boltzmann distribution curve is a graph that shows the distribution of energies at certain temperature.

blocks.prompt:
31 How does the Boltzmann distribution curve change when the temperature is raised? What is the result?
(Temperature barhane par Boltzmann curve kaise badalta hai? Is ka nateeja kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Zyada temperature par curve chapta ho jata hai aur peak daayen khisak jati hai, kyunke particles ki average kinetic energy barhti hai. 10 °C barhne par Eₐ se aage shaded area taqreeban do guna hota hai, is liye rate barhta hai.

book_ref.quote: The curve showing the Boltzmann distribution at the higher temperature flattens and the peak shifts to the right.

blocks.prompt:
32 The rate of a reaction triples for every 10 °C rise in temperature. By what factor does the rate increase when the temperature is raised from 30 °C to 50 °C?
(Aik reaction ka rate har 10 °C par teen guna hota hai. 30 °C se 50 °C karne par rate kitna guna barhega?)
blocks.explanation: Izafa = 20 °C = do dafa 10 °C. Factor = 3 × 3 = 9. Rate 9 guna ho jayega.

book_ref.quote: rate either doubles or triples for every 10 °C rise in temperature

blocks.prompt:
33 Define catalyst and catalysis.
(Catalyst aur catalysis ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Catalyst woh shay hai jo reaction ka rate badal de magar reaction ke aakhir mein kimiyaai taur par wohi rahe; aksar bohat thori miqdaar mein hota hai. Catalyst ki maujoodgi mein hone wala amal catalysis kehlata hai.

book_ref.quote: A catalyst is defined as a substance which alters the rate of a chemical reaction, but remains chemically unchanged at the end of the reaction.

blocks.prompt:
34 Write equations for two reactions speeded up by a catalyst, naming the catalyst in each.
(Catalyst se tez hone wale do reactions ki equations catalyst ke naam ke saath likhein.)
blocks.explanation: 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O (catalyst Pt); is ke baghair aam temperature par bohat aahista. 2KClO₃ → 2KCl + 3O₂ (thori si MnO₂). Aur 4HCl + O₂ → 2H₂O + 2Cl₂ (CuCl₂).

book_ref.quote: KClO₃ decomposes much more rapidly in the presence of a small amount of MnO₂.

blocks.prompt:
35 Differentiate between homogeneous and heterogeneous catalysis.
(Homogeneous aur heterogeneous catalysis mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Farq yeh hai ke catalyst aur reactants aik phase mein hain ya nahi.

book_ref.quote: the catalyst and the reactants are in the same phase and the reacting system is homogeneous throughout

rows: Catalyst aur reactants aik hi phase mein.
Catalyst aur reactants mukhtalif phases mein.
Catalyst yaksaan phaila hota hai; system har jagah homogeneous.
Aksar catalyst solid aur reactants gas ya liquid.
Misaal: NO(g) ke saath 2SO₂(g) + O₂(g) → 2SO₃(g).
Misaal: Pt par 4NH₃(g) + 5O₂(g) → 4NO(g) + 6H₂O(g).
Misaal: H₂SO₄ ke saath ester ki hydrolysis (solution).
Misaal: Ni par C₂H₄(g) + H₂(g) → C₂H₆(g).

blocks.prompt:
36 Give two examples of heterogeneous catalysis with equations.
(Heterogeneous catalysis ki do misalein equations ke saath dein.)
blocks.explanation: Platinum gauze par ammonia ka oxidation (HNO₃ banane ke liye): 4NH₃(g) + 5O₂(g) → 4NO(g) + 6H₂O(g) (Pt, 800 °C). Bareek Ni, Pd ya Pt par hydrogenation: C₂H₄(g) + H₂(g) → C₂H₆(g) (Ni, 150 °C).

book_ref.quote: Hydrogenation of unsaturated organic compounds are catalysed by finely divided Ni, Pd or Pt.

blocks.prompt:
37 Give two examples of homogeneous catalysis.
(Homogeneous catalysis ki do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) NO(g) catalyst ke saath 2SO₂(g) + O₂(g) → 2SO₃(g); reactants aur catalyst sab gases. (2) H₂SO₄ ke saath ester ki hydrolysis: CH₃COOCH₂CH₃ + H₂O → CH₃COOH + CH₃CH₂OH; sab solution mein.

book_ref.quote: Esters are hydrolyzed in the presence of H₂SO₄.

blocks.prompt:
38 What are enzymes? Name the factors that influence enzyme activity.
(Enzymes kya hain? Enzyme ki activity par asar daalne wale factors ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Enzymes biochemical catalysts (qudrat ke catalysts) hain, aam taur par proteins, jo jaandaaron mein reactions ki activation energy kam karke rate barhate hain. In ki activity par pH, temperature aur substrate ki concentration asar daalte hain.

book_ref.quote: Factors such as pH, temperature, and the concentration of substrate molecules can influence enzyme activity.

blocks.prompt:
39 What are coenzymes? How are vitamins related to catalysis?
(Coenzymes kya hain? Vitamins ka catalysis se kya taaluq hai?)
blocks.explanation: Coenzymes organic molecules hain jo enzymes ko behtar catalyse karne mein madad dete hain. Vitamins biochemical reactions mein, khaas kar coenzymes ban kar, catalyst ka kaam karte hain; maslan vitamin K khoon jamne ke liye zaroori hai. Vitamin ki kami cofactor ki kami hai.

book_ref.quote: Coenzymes are organic molecules that help enzymes catalyze reactions more efficiently.

blocks.prompt:
40 What is a rate law? Write the rate equation for the general reaction aA + bB → cC + dD.
(Rate law kya hai? aA + bB → cC + dD ke liye rate equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Rate law woh equation hai jo rate ko reactants ki concentrations se jorti hai, jin ki powers tajurbe se maloom hoti hain. Rate = k[A]ˣ[B]ʸ; x aur y tajurbati hain aur a, b ke barabar ho bhi sakte hain aur nahi bhi; k rate constant hai.

book_ref.quote: A rate law is an equation that relates the rate of a reaction to the concentrations of reactants raised to various powers according to the experimental data.

blocks.prompt:
41 Define the specific rate constant. Show that it equals the rate when all concentrations are unity.
(Specific rate constant ki definition likhein. Dikhayein ke concentrations ikaai (1) hon to yeh rate ke barabar hai.)
blocks.explanation: Specific rate constant woh rate hai jab reactants ki concentrations ikaai hon. Rate = k[A]ˣ[B]ʸ mein [A] = [B] = 1 mol dm⁻³ rakhein: Rate = k × 1ˣ × 1ʸ = k.

book_ref.quote: is the rate of reaction when the concentrations of the reactants are unity

blocks.prompt:
42 Does the rate constant change when the concentrations of reactants change? What changes it?
(Kya concentrations badalne se rate constant badalta hai? Isay kya badalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Diye gaye halaat mein k concentrations ke baawajood sabit rehta hai; rate concentration se badalta hai, k nahi. k temperature se badalta hai.

book_ref.quote: Under the given conditions, k remains constant, but it changes with temperature.

blocks.prompt:
43 For a reaction Rate = k[A][B] with k = 3.0 × 10⁻² dm³ mol⁻¹ s⁻¹, calculate the rate when [A] = 0.20 mol dm⁻³ and [B] = 0.15 mol dm⁻³.
(Rate = k[A][B], k = 3.0 × 10⁻² dm³ mol⁻¹ s⁻¹. [A] = 0.20 aur [B] = 0.15 mol dm⁻³ par rate nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: The brackets [ ] represent the molar concentrations

blocks.prompt:
44 Define order of reaction with respect to a reactant and the overall order.
(Kisi reactant ke lihaaz se order aur overall order ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Kisi reactant ka order rate equation mein us ki concentration ka exponent hai. Rate = k[A]ˣ[B]ʸ mein A ka order x, B ka y; overall order (x + y).

book_ref.quote: Thus, the reaction is of order ‘x’ with respect to A and of order ‘y’ with respect to B.

blocks.prompt:
45 Why can the order of a reaction not be found from its balanced equation? Give an example.
(Reaction ka order balanced equation se kyun nahi nikala ja sakta? Misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Order tajurbe se maloom hota hai; exponents coefficients ke barabar hon zaroori nahi. Misaal: 2H₂ + 2NO → N₂ + 2H₂O ka rate = k[H₂][NO]²: H₂ mein first order halaanke coefficient 2 hai; overall third order.

book_ref.quote: It is important to note that the order of a reaction is an experimentally determined quantity

blocks.prompt:
46 For Rate = k[X]²[Y], how does the rate change if [X] is doubled and [Y] is halved at the same time?
(Rate = k[X]²[Y] mein agar [X] do guna aur [Y] aadha aik saath kar diya jaaye to rate kaise badlega?)
blocks.explanation: Naya rate = k(2[X])²(½[Y]) = 4 × ½ = 2 guna. Rate do guna ho jayega.

book_ref.quote: The order of a reaction defines how the reactant concentration influences its rate.

blocks.prompt:
47 What is a zero order reaction? Give two examples.
(Zero order reaction kya hai? Do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Is ka rate reactants ki concentration par munhasir nahi: Rate = k[A]⁰ = k. Misalein: H₂ + Cl₂ → 2HCl, Rate = k; 2NH₃ → N₂ + 3H₂, Rate = k. Photochemical reactions aam taur par zero order hote hain.

book_ref.quote: A change in the concentration has no effect on the speed of the reaction.

blocks.prompt:
48 Show that the decomposition of N₂O₅ is a first order reaction.
(Saabit karein ke N₂O₅ ki decomposition first order reaction hai.)

blocks.explanation: Jis reaction ke rate equation ke exponents ka majmua kasr (fraction) ho. Misaal: CHCl₃ + Cl₂ → CCl₄ + HCl, Rate = k[CHCl₃][Cl₂]^(1/2), n = 1.5. Free radicals wale reactions aksar fractional order dikhate hain.

book_ref.quote: A reaction in which the sum of exponents of rate equation is in fraction, is called the fractional order reaction.

book_ref.quote: This step controls the overall rate of the reaction because it limits the speed at which the reaction can proceed.
